id.heading: Filosofi Rancago Framework
id.subtitle: Hexagonal Architecture · IoC Container · SOLID Native Go Framework

sections.title: Apa itu Rancago Framework?
sections.description: Rancago adalah framework Go modern yang dibangun di atas pola Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters). Setiap komponen sistem diisolasi dalam lapisan domain, ports, application, adapters, dan bootstrap — memungkinkan penggantian infrastruktur (database, cache, storage, transport) tanpa menyentuh logika bisnis.

callout.title: ᮛᮔ᮪ᮎᮌ᮰ — Filosofi Sunda Nusantara
callout.message: Kata "Rancago" terinspirasi dari kearifan lokal Sunda: "Rancagé" yang bermakna cekatan, terampil, inovatif, dan penuh daya cipta. Nilai ini diwujudkan dalam kode yang bersih, terstruktur, dan saling menopang melalui prinsip "Silih Asah, Silih Asih, Silih Asuh".

sections.title: Pilar Utama Rancago
sections.description: Framework ini dibangun di atas fondasi teknis yang kuat untuk kebutuhan produksi enterprise:
bullets: 🏛️ Hexagonal Architecture: Pemisahan ketat domain → ports → application → adapters → bootstrap tanpa kebocoran dependensi.
🔧 IoC Service Container: Binding Singleton/Transient/Instance dengan Alias resolution dan thread-safe MustResolve.
🛡️ ServiceProvider Pattern: Register + Boot lifecycle untuk bootstrapping modular tanpa urutan yang rumit.
📦 Multi-Storage Manager: MinIO/S3/Google Drive dengan factory OCP — tambah driver tanpa ubah Manager.
🔐 OAuth Socialite + Redis RBAC: Google/GitHub/Facebook dengan role & permission berlapis.
📡 Notification 3-in-1: REST + gRPC + WebSocket dari satu use case yang sama.
🔍 pgvector Semantic Search: Generic Repository[T] dengan HNSW cosine index 1536-dimensi.

sections.title: Entrypoint Utama
sections.description: Server Rancago menjalankan HTTP dan gRPC secara bersamaan dari root main.go:

codeSnippet.code:
package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/rancago/framework/bootstrap"
)

func main() {
	app := bootstrap.New()
	app.RegisterCore()
	app.Boot()

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(),
		syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()

	errCh := make(chan error, 2)
	go func() { errCh <- app.StartHTTP(ctx) }()
	go func() { errCh <- app.StartGRPC(ctx) }()

	if err := <-errCh; err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("[rancago] fatal: %v", err)
	}
}

en.heading: Rancago Framework Philosophy
en.subtitle: Hexagonal Architecture · IoC Container · SOLID Native Go Framework

sections.title: What is Rancago Framework?
sections.description: Rancago is a modern Go framework built on the Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) pattern. Every component is strictly isolated into domain, ports, application, adapters, and bootstrap layers — making it trivial to swap infrastructure (database, cache, storage, transport) without touching business logic.

callout.title: ᮛᮔ᮪ᮎᮌ᮰ — Sundanese Cultural Wisdom
callout.message: "Rancago" derives from the Sundanese word "Rancagé" — representing dexterity, innovation, and inventive craftsmanship. This ethos is expressed in clean, composable code guided by "Silih Asah, Silih Asih, Silih Asuh": sharpen each other, care for each other, nurture each other.

sections.title: Core Pillars of Rancago
sections.description: The framework is built on a strong technical foundation for enterprise production use:
bullets: 🏛️ Hexagonal Architecture: Strict separation of domain → ports → application → adapters → bootstrap with no dependency leakage.
🔧 IoC Service Container: Singleton/Transient/Instance bindings with Alias resolution and thread-safe MustResolve.
🛡️ ServiceProvider Pattern: Register + Boot lifecycle for modular bootstrapping without complex ordering.
📦 Multi-Storage Manager: MinIO/S3/Google Drive with OCP factory — add a new driver without touching Manager.
🔐 OAuth Socialite + Redis RBAC: Google/GitHub/Facebook with layered role & permission checks.
📡 3-in-1 Notifications: REST + gRPC + WebSocket delivered from a single use case.
🔍 pgvector Semantic Search: Generic Repository[T] with 1536-dimension HNSW cosine index.

	go func() { errCh <- app.StartGRPC(ctx) }()

	if err := <-errCh; err != nil {

	}

summary.id: Langkah praktis dari instalasi rancago CLI sampai membuat dan menjalankan proyek pertama.
summary.en: Practical steps from installing the rancago CLI to creating and running your first project.

id.heading: Install sampai Proyek Pertama
id.subtitle: Installer → Verifikasi → Init Go module → Scaffold → Run

sections.title: 1) Install rancago (CLI)
sections.description: Rancago menggunakan CLI bernama `rancago` untuk scaffolding dan utilitas. Cara instalasi paling simpel adalah menggunakan repo rancago-install.

codeSnippet.code:
# Linux / macOS
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.sh | bash

# Windows (PowerShell)
iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.ps1 | iex

# Alternatif (Go)
go install github.com/rancago/rancago-cli@latest

sections.title: 2) Verifikasi instalasi
sections.description: Pastikan perintah `rancago` bisa dipanggil dari terminal dan versi terbaca.

codeSnippet.code: rancago version\nrancago help

sections.title: 3) Buat proyek Go baru
sections.description: CLI bekerja di dalam folder proyek Anda. Buat folder proyek, inisialisasi Go module, lalu tambahkan dependency framework.

codeSnippet.code: mkdir my-app && cd my-app\ngo mod init github.com/you/my-app\ngo get github.com/rancago/framework@latest

sections.title: 4) Buat entrypoint `main.go`
sections.description: Minimal entrypoint untuk menjalankan HTTP + gRPC secara bersamaan.

codeSnippet.code:
package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/rancago/framework/bootstrap"
)

func main() {
	app := bootstrap.New()
	app.RegisterCore()
	app.Boot()

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()

	errCh := make(chan error, 2)
	go func() { errCh <- app.StartHTTP(ctx) }()
	go func() { errCh <- app.StartGRPC(ctx) }()

	if err := <-errCh; err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("[rancago] fatal: %v", err)
	}
}

sections.title: 5) Scaffold fitur pertama
sections.description: Mulai dari bounded context (scaffold) atau langsung dari feature generator. Hasilnya akan ditempatkan ke struktur `internal/` sesuai Hexagonal Architecture.
bullets: Gunakan `rancago scaffold <Name>` untuk scaffolding interaktif satu bounded context lengkap.
Gunakan `rancago make:feature <Name>` untuk membuat feature + docs/features/<name>.md.

codeSnippet.code: rancago scaffold Order\n# atau\nrancago make:feature Order

callout.title: Menjalankan server
callout.message: Untuk menjalankan server, gunakan `go run .` di root proyek. Perintah `rancago serve` berguna sebagai utilitas dev, namun proses server tetap berasal dari kode proyek Anda.

sections.title: 6) Menjalankan unit test
sections.description: Unit test membantu memastikan perubahan pada domain/usecase tetap aman. Rancago memakai `testing` bawaan Go (tanpa framework tambahan) sehingga bisa langsung dijalankan.

codeSnippet.code:
# Jalankan seluruh test
go test ./...

# Jalankan dengan coverage
go test -cover ./...

# Jalankan 1 package + verbose
go test ./internal/domain/valueobjects -v

callout.title: Prioritas test yang ideal
callout.message: Mulai dari Value Objects (deterministik), lanjut repository in-memory (CRUD/pagination), lalu naik ke usecase dengan fake/mocks di layer ports.

sections.title: 5) Scaffold your first feature
sections.description: Start with a bounded context (interactive scaffold) or a feature generator. Output is placed under `internal/` following Hexagonal Architecture.
bullets: Use `rancago scaffold <Name>` for an interactive full bounded-context scaffold.
Use `rancago make:feature <Name>` to generate a feature + docs/features/<name>.md.

codeSnippet.code: rancago scaffold Order\n# or\nrancago make:feature Order

callout.title: Running the server
callout.message: To run the server, use `go run .` in your project root. The `rancago serve` command can help as a dev utility, but the server process still comes from your project's code.

sections.title: 6) Running unit tests
sections.description: Unit tests help keep domain/usecase changes safe. Rancago uses Go's built-in `testing` package (no extra framework) so you can run tests immediately.

codeSnippet.code:

go test ./...

# Run with coverage
go test -cover ./...

# Run a single package + verbose
go test ./internal/domain/valueobjects -v

callout.title: Recommended test order
callout.message: Start with deterministic Value Objects, then in-memory repositories (CRUD/pagination), and finally usecases using fakes/mocks at the ports layer.

summary.id: Pola Ports & Adapters dengan 6 lapisan: domain, ports, application, adapters, bootstrap, cmd.
summary.en: Ports & Adapters pattern with 6 layers: domain, ports, application, adapters, bootstrap, cmd.

id.heading: Arsitektur Hexagonal Rancago
id.subtitle: Domain → Ports → Application → Adapters → Bootstrap → Cmd

sections.title: 6 Lapisan Hexagonal
sections.description: Setiap lapisan memiliki tanggung jawab yang jelas dan dependensi yang hanya mengalir ke dalam (inward):
bullets: 1. domain/: Entity murni Go + Value Objects + Domain Errors. Nol dependensi eksternal.
2. ports/driven/: Interface outbound (Repository, CachePort, StorageDriver, WebSocketPort, SocialitePort).
3. ports/driving/: Interface inbound (NotificationUseCase, UserUseCase, DocumentUseCase).
4. application/usecases/: Interactor — logika bisnis, mengimplementasi driving port, inject driven port.
5. adapters/driven/: Implementasi konkret: in-memory, Redis, Storage, WebSocket, Auth.
6. adapters/driving/: HTTP handler, gRPC adapter, CLI adapter — entry point dari luar.
7. bootstrap/app.go: Kernel — wiring seluruh IoC container dan provider.
8. cmd/rancago-server/: Entry point server (HTTP + gRPC).

en.heading: Rancago Hexagonal Architecture
en.subtitle: Domain → Ports → Application → Adapters → Bootstrap → Cmd

sections.title: 6 Hexagonal Layers
sections.description: Each layer has a clear responsibility and dependencies only flow inward:
bullets: 1. domain/: Pure Go entities + Value Objects + Domain Errors. Zero external dependencies.
2. ports/driven/: Outbound interfaces (Repository, CachePort, StorageDriver, WebSocketPort, SocialitePort).
3. ports/driving/: Inbound interfaces (NotificationUseCase, UserUseCase, DocumentUseCase).
4. application/usecases/: Interactors — business logic, implements driving ports, injects driven ports.
5. adapters/driven/: Concrete implementations: in-memory, Redis, Storage, WebSocket, Auth.
6. adapters/driving/: HTTP handlers, gRPC adapters, CLI adapter — external entry points.
7. bootstrap/app.go: Kernel — wires the entire IoC container and providers.
8. cmd/rancago-server/: Server entry point (HTTP + gRPC).

summary.id: Container thread-safe dengan Singleton, Transient, Instance, Alias, Resolve, dan MustResolve.
summary.en: Thread-safe container with Singleton, Transient, Instance, Alias, Resolve, and MustResolve.

sections.title: Jenis Binding yang Didukung
sections.description: Container mendukung tiga lifecycle binding ditambah alias untuk memudahkan resolusi interface:
bullets: Singleton: Satu instance seumur hidup container — dibuat saat pertama kali di-resolve.
Transient (Bind): Instance baru setiap kali di-resolve.
Instance: Instance yang sudah jadi, langsung didaftarkan ke container.
Alias: Pemetaan alias → key konkret, mendukung resolusi berbasis interface.

sections.description: Resolve bisa menggunakan key langsung atau alias yang telah terdaftar:

sections.title: Supported Binding Types
sections.description: The container supports three binding lifecycles plus aliases for interface-based resolution:
bullets: Singleton: One instance per container lifetime — created on first resolve.
Transient (Bind): New instance on every resolve.
Instance: Pre-built instance registered directly into the container.
Alias: Maps alias names to concrete keys, enabling interface-based resolution.

sections.title: Registration in Bootstrap

sections.title: 5 Prinsip SOLID dalam Konteks Rancago
sections.description: Setiap prinsip SOLID diimplementasi melalui konvensi arsitektur, bukan hanya dokumentasi:
bullets: S — Single Responsibility: Satu file = satu tanggung jawab. Entity hanya berisi state & behavior domain. Use case hanya berisi orkestrasi bisnis.
O — Open/Closed: Storage.Manager.RegisterFactory() dan SocialiteManager.RegisterDriver() adalah extension point OCP — tambah kemampuan tanpa ubah kode lama.
L — Liskov Substitution: Semua adapter driven (InMemory, Redis, Storage) dapat disubstitusi karena mengimplementasi interface port yang sama.
I — Interface Segregation: Port driven dan driving dipisah granular: NotificationRepository terpisah dari UserRepository terpisah dari CachePort.
D — Dependency Inversion: Use case hanya bergantung pada interface port — tidak pernah pada struct konkret adapter.

en.heading: SOLID in Rancago
en.subtitle: Architecture as a Design Principle Enforcement Mechanism

sections.title: 5 SOLID Principles in the Rancago Context
sections.description: Each SOLID principle is implemented through architectural conventions, not just documentation:
bullets: S — Single Responsibility: One file = one responsibility. Entity only holds domain state & behavior. Use case only holds business orchestration.
O — Open/Closed: Storage.Manager.RegisterFactory() and SocialiteManager.RegisterDriver() are OCP extension points — add capabilities without modifying existing code.
L — Liskov Substitution: All driven adapters (InMemory, Redis, Storage) are substitutable because they implement the same port interface.
I — Interface Segregation: Driven and driving ports are granularly separated: NotificationRepository is separate from UserRepository separate from CachePort.
D — Dependency Inversion: Use cases depend only on port interfaces — never on concrete adapter structs.

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant HTTPHandler
  participant NotifUseCase
  participant Repository
  participant Redis
  participant WSHub
  participant WSClient

  HTTPHandler->>NotifUseCase: Send(userID, title, body, channel)
  NotifUseCase->>Repository: Create(notification)
  Repository-->>NotifUseCase: saved notification
  NotifUseCase->>Redis: INCR notif:unread:{userID}
  NotifUseCase->>WSHub: SendDirect(userID, msg)
  NotifUseCase->>WSHub: PublishChannel("user:{id}", msg)
  WSHub->>Redis: PUBLISH rancago:ws:user:{id}
  WSHub->>WSClient: push real-time message
  NotifUseCase-->>HTTPHandler: notification response
  HTTPHandler-->>Client: 200 OK + notification JSON

sections.title: Contoh Isi FEATURE.md
sections.description: File docs/features/order.md yang dihasilkan otomatis oleh rancago make:feature Order:

codeSnippet.code:
<!-- CONTEXT_START
module: github.com/rancago/framework
feature: Order
generated: 2026-01-15
arch: hexagonal (ports-and-adapters)
CONTEXT_END -->

# Feature: Order

> Manage customer orders

## 📋 Instructions

<!-- INSTRUCTION
1. Domain entities MUST NOT import ports or adapters.
2. Ports are Go interfaces only — no implementations.
3. Use cases depend on driven ports (injected via constructor).
4. Adapters depend on driving ports — never on use case structs.
5. Wire new bindings in internal/bootstrap/app.go (Container.Singleton).
6. Use derrors.New(op, sentinel, msg) for domain errors.
7. IDs use valueobjects.ID — call valueobjects.NewIDStr() or NewIDUint().
INSTRUCTION -->

## 📁 Generated Files

| Layer | File | Role |
|-------|------|------|
| Domain Entity | `internal/domain/entities/Order.go` | Core business object |
| Driven Port | `internal/ports/driven/OrderRepository.go` | Persistence contract |
| Driving Port | `internal/ports/driving/OrderUseCase.go` | Inbound contract |
| Use Case | `internal/application/usecases/order_usecase.go` | Business logic |
| HTTP Adapter | `internal/adapters/driving/orderhandler/orderhandler_adapter.go` | HTTP entry point |

## 🏗️ Layer Flow

```
HTTP/gRPC/CLI
  └─ Driving Adapter (internal/adapters/driving/)
       └─ Driving Port  (internal/ports/driving/OrderUseCase)
            └─ Use Case     (internal/application/usecases/order_usecase.go)
                 └─ Driven Port  (internal/ports/driven/OrderRepository)
                      └─ Domain      (internal/domain/entities/Order.go)
```

## 🚨 Domain Errors

```go
return derrors.New("order.create", derrors.ErrValidation, "amount is required")
return derrors.New("order.cancel", derrors.ErrConflict, "order already shipped")
```

7. IDs use valueobjects.ID — call valueobjects.NewIDStr() or NewIDUint().
INSTRUCTION -->

## 📁 Generated Files

| Layer | File | Role |
|-------|------|------|
| Domain Entity | `internal/domain/entities/Order.go` | Core business object |
| Driven Port | `internal/ports/driven/OrderRepository.go` | Persistence contract |
| Driving Port | `internal/ports/driving/OrderUseCase.go` | Inbound contract |
| Use Case | `internal/application/usecases/order_usecase.go` | Business logic |
| HTTP Adapter | `internal/adapters/driving/orderhandler/orderhandler_adapter.go` | HTTP entry point |

## 🏗️ Layer Flow

```
HTTP/gRPC/CLI
  └─ Driving Adapter (internal/adapters/driving/)
       └─ Driving Port  (internal/ports/driving/OrderUseCase)
            └─ Use Case     (internal/application/usecases/order_usecase.go)
                 └─ Driven Port  (internal/ports/driven/OrderRepository)
                      └─ Domain      (internal/domain/entities/Order.go)
```

## 🚨 Domain Errors

```go
return derrors.New("order.create", derrors.ErrValidation, "amount is required")
return derrors.New("order.cancel", derrors.ErrConflict, "order already shipped")
```

summary.id: Instal Rancago Framework dan CLI via curl (install.sh), PowerShell (install.ps1), atau go install.
summary.en: Install Rancago Framework and CLI via curl (install.sh), PowerShell (install.ps1), or go install.

sections.title: Persyaratan Sistem
sections.description: Rancago Framework membutuhkan lingkungan berikut:
bullets: Go 1.21 atau lebih baru (https://go.dev/dl/)
PostgreSQL 15+ dengan ekstensi pgvector (untuk fitur semantic search)
Redis 7+ (untuk caching, WebSocket PubSub, dan RBAC)
Git (untuk rancago-cli scaffold dengan git init)

sections.title: Cara 1: go install (Direkomendasikan)
sections.description: Cara paling mudah untuk menginstal rancago-cli dan framework sekaligus:

codeSnippet.code:
# Install rancago-cli
go install github.com/rancago/rancago-cli@latest

# Tambahkan framework sebagai dependensi proyek
go get github.com/rancago/framework@latest

# Verifikasi
rancago --version
# rancago-cli v1.0.0 (ᮛᮔ᮪ᮎᮌ᮰)

sections.title: Cara 2: curl / install.sh (Linux & macOS)
sections.description: Skrip shell otomatis yang mendeteksi OS dan arsitektur, mengunduh binary yang tepat:

codeSnippet.code:
# Download dan jalankan installer
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.sh | bash

# Atau unduh dulu dan periksa sebelum dijalankan (lebih aman)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.sh -o install.sh
less install.sh  # periksa isi skrip
bash install.sh

# Tambahkan ke PATH jika belum
export PATH="$HOME/.rancago/bin:$PATH"
echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.rancago/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc

sections.title: Cara 3: PowerShell (Windows)
sections.description: Installer PowerShell untuk Windows yang mengunduh dan menginstal binary rancago-cli:

codeSnippet.code:
# Jalankan langsung
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.ps1 | iex

# Atau unduh dan periksa dulu
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.ps1 -OutFile install.ps1
notepad install.ps1  # periksa isi skrip
.\install.ps1

# Verifikasi
rancago --version

sections.title: Mulai Proyek Baru
sections.description: Setelah instalasi, langkah-langkah untuk memulai proyek Rancago baru:

codeSnippet.code:
# Clone template atau inisialisasi modul baru
mkdir my-app && cd my-app
go mod init github.com/username/my-app
go get github.com/rancago/framework@latest

# Generate APP_KEY
rancago key:generate
# → APP_KEY=base64:... (salin ke .env)

# Buat fitur pertama
rancago make:feature User
rancago make:feature Product

# Wire di bootstrap, jalankan server
go run main.go
# [rancago] HTTP server listening on :8080
# [rancago] gRPC server listening on :50051

callout.title: 💡 Tips
callout.message: Gunakan rancago tinker untuk menjelajahi container bindings dan daftar port yang tersedia sebelum mulai mengimplementasi fitur baru.

sections.title: Diagram Alur Instalasi
sections.description: Tiga jalur instalasi dan alur setup proyek:

codeSnippet.code:
flowchart TD
  Start([Mulai Instalasi])
  Start --> GoInstall["go install\ngithub.com/rancago/rancago-cli@latest"]
  Start --> Curl["curl -fsSL install.sh | bash\n(Linux/macOS)"]
  Start --> Pwsh["irm install.ps1 | iex\n(Windows PowerShell)"]

  GoInstall --> Verify[rancago --version]
  Curl --> Verify
  Pwsh --> Verify

  Verify --> NewProject[mkdir my-app && go mod init]
  NewProject --> GetFramework["go get github.com/rancago/framework@latest"]
  GetFramework --> KeyGen[rancago key:generate]
  KeyGen --> MakeFeature[rancago make:feature MyFeature]
  MakeFeature --> Wire[Wire di bootstrap/app.go]
  Wire --> Run[go run main.go]
  Run --> Done(["✅ HTTP :8080 + gRPC :50051 berjalan!"])

sections.title: System Requirements
sections.description: Rancago Framework requires the following environment:
bullets: Go 1.21 or newer (https://go.dev/dl/)
PostgreSQL 15+ with pgvector extension (for semantic search features)
Redis 7+ (for caching, WebSocket PubSub, and RBAC)
Git (for rancago-cli scaffold with git init)

sections.title: Method 1: go install (Recommended)
sections.description: The easiest way to install both rancago-cli and the framework:

codeSnippet.code:
# Install rancago-cli
go install github.com/rancago/rancago-cli@latest

# Add framework as a project dependency
go get github.com/rancago/framework@latest

# Verify
rancago --version
# rancago-cli v1.0.0 (ᮛᮔ᮪ᮎᮌ᮰)

sections.title: Method 2: curl / install.sh (Linux & macOS)
sections.description: Shell script that auto-detects OS and architecture, downloads the correct binary:

codeSnippet.code:
# Download and run installer
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.sh | bash

# Or download first and inspect before running (safer)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.sh -o install.sh
less install.sh  # inspect the script
bash install.sh

# Add to PATH if not already
export PATH="$HOME/.rancago/bin:$PATH"
echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.rancago/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc

sections.title: Method 3: PowerShell (Windows)
sections.description: PowerShell installer for Windows that downloads and installs the rancago-cli binary:

codeSnippet.code:
# Run directly
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.ps1 | iex

# Or download and inspect first
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancago/rancago-install/main/install.ps1 -OutFile install.ps1
notepad install.ps1  # inspect the script
.\install.ps1

# Verify
rancago --version

sections.title: Starting a New Project
sections.description: After installation, steps to start a new Rancago project:

codeSnippet.code:
# Initialize a new module
mkdir my-app && cd my-app
go mod init github.com/username/my-app
go get github.com/rancago/framework@latest

# Generate APP_KEY
rancago key:generate
# → APP_KEY=base64:... (copy to .env)

# Create your first features
rancago make:feature User
rancago make:feature Product

# Wire in bootstrap, run the server
go run main.go
# [rancago] HTTP server listening on :8080
# [rancago] gRPC server listening on :50051
